The '''Prefect of Police''' was a [[Police rank|title]] used to denote the chief [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] of the [[Tahv Constabulary]], a professional [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Despite the seniority of this position, one of its known holders [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Prince/Legends|princess]] [[Takara Hilts]] regarded it as inferior to other positions like the [[Grand Lord]]'s [[Grand Lord's Hands|Hands]], [[Sith Saber]]s and even [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]]. The Prefect's job profile included apprehending and eliminating criminals, petty vandals and other low-level enemies of the Sith establishment.
